title: Divergence: forge proof cache — a stale same-version (thermite 0.1.0) pre-#12 L3-clean cert bypasses the §7 mutation gate on a warm check

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_mutation.rs::divergence_stale_same_version_cache_entry_bypasses_mutation_gate demonstrates the divergence. cache::cache_key = (lowered_src, seed, verus_version, THERMITE_VERSION). Commit fa55760 introduced the mutation gate but did NOT bump forge's version (Cargo.toml still 0.1.0), and neither the gate's existence nor the floor is in the key. A cert stored by pre-#12 forge (#5/#6/#13 all ship at 0.1.0 and populate the same target/ cache) for a weak-contract fn is an L3-clean cert under the identical key; a post-#12 warm check serves it on a HIT (check::check_file_with_options ~line 273) BEFORE the gate runs. The test confirms: cold check gates `ens result <= 1000000` WeakContract (1/2 < 0.60); a planted stale same-version L3-clean cert is re-served as level=L3 cached=true mutants_killed=0/0 (and the served cert is internally inconsistent — its obligations array still carries the WeakContract diagnostic). Reachability: NOT version-guarded — same thermite version 0.1.0. Owning crate: forge (cache/check). Fix: the gate-introducing commit must invalidate the cache (bump THERMITE_VERSION or add a gate/floor tag to cache_key).

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Plan: commit the two failing divergence tests (forge/tests/divergence_mutation.rs) that pin the 0/0-escape (#48) and the stale same-version cache-bypass (#49). Tests are the audit artifact (R-DEFER-3); both are release-blockers, left un-ignored so they ARE the block until a fixer lands. No production code touched (critic role).

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Fixed in 6d7b3af. Root cause: cache_key omitted the verdict-affecting check-logic version, so the #12 §7 mutation gate (shipped at the same forge 0.1.0) left a pre-gate L3-clean cert under the IDENTICAL key, re-served on a warm HIT and bypassing the gate. Fix (single file forge/src/cache.rs): +CHECK_SCHEMA_VERSION as a 5th domain-tagged length-prefixed cache_key input with a bump-on-gate-change maintenance contract; cache::load now treats an internally-inconsistent entry (clean reject:None but a Failed obligation) as a MISS, forcing re-check under current gates. divergence_stale_same_version_cache_entry_bypasses_mutation_gate now PASSES. No regression: cache_hit_serves_l3_with_verus_unavailable + second_run_is_a_cache_hit + corpus sum/binary_search L3 cold+warm all green. Gauntlet: cargo test --workspace 255 passed 0 failed; clippy -D warnings PASS; fmt --check PASS. cache_key stays pure (R-CODE-5). No conformance fixtures or test assertions touched.
